scope: Isolated real core experiment; verify the sequence in the live app.
auto_only_constraint: 30% prototype storage reserve, checked against actual inflow and due arrivals each step
forecast_source: Frozen historical LSTM outputs, advancing one issue date per day
limitations: Historical forecasts are not predictions of the fixed simulation inflows.
Manual guard uses current inflows; AUTO uses its forecast scenario, matching application behavior.
Fixed gate policies are baselines, not all possible human decisions.
This experiment does not evaluate GCN-LSTM control; it remains advisory.

policies.policy: Fixed manual: A0 B50 C0 D25
Extra core check: fixed gates plus identical reserve
